query.description: Case-insensitive substring match against name OR email.

Filter syntax: <column><operator><value>. Operators: =, !=, >, <, >=, <=, ~ (LIKE), ~* (ILIKE), !~, !~*, $ (IN, comma-separated), !$ (NOT IN), .. (BETWEEN, 'a and b'), !.. (NOT BETWEEN), _ (IS NULL), !_ (IS NOT NULL). Allowed columns: id, name, email, role, number, phone_number, birth_date, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at. Repeat the param for multiple filters (AND-ed). Note: referencing deleted_at auto-unscopes the soft-delete filter and exposes trashed users.
Example: case-insensitive LIKE match on name.
Example: BETWEEN range on created_at. Use 'a and b' or 'a,b'.
Example: only trashed (soft-deleted) users. Auto-unscopes the soft-delete filter.
Example: users trashed in date range. Auto-unscopes the soft-delete filter.

Sort syntax: <column> (asc) or -<column> (desc) or +<column> (asc). Allowed columns: id, name, email, role, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at. Repeat the param for multi-column sort (applied left-to-right). Note: sort by deleted_at auto-unscopes and includes trashed users.
Example: secondary sort by name ASC.

request.description:
Paginated user list. Admin+ only.

## Pagination
- `page` (>=1, default 1) and `limit` (1-100, default 10).
- Response envelope includes `from`, `to`, `total`, `last_page`, plus `first_page_url`, `prev_page_url`, `next_page_url`, `last_page_url` (URLs preserve all active query params).

## Search
- `search=<text>` does case-insensitive substring match on name OR email.

## Filters
- `filters=<col><op><val>`. Repeat for multiple (AND-ed).
- Allowed columns: id, name, email, role, number, phone_number, birth_date, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at. Filters on other columns are silently dropped.
- Referencing `deleted_at` in any filter or sort **bypasses the soft-delete scope** and exposes trashed users. Use `filters=deleted_at!_` for only trashed, `filters=deleted_at_` for only live.
- Operators: see query param descriptions.

## Sorts
- `sorts=<col>` (asc), `sorts=-<col>` (desc). Repeat for multi-column.
- Allowed columns: id, name, email, role, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at. Default sort: `created_at DESC`.
- Disallowed columns are silently dropped. Sort by `deleted_at` auto-unscopes.

## Errors
- 422 (100040) on invalid filter/sort syntax, page<1, limit<1 or limit>100.
- 403 (200142) when caller is below Admin role.
